Local mode configuration requires loopback app/database hosts and rejects Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials. The local reconciliation construction is guarded by localTestMode and injects createLocalAlpacaAccountFetch; that transport has no global-fetch fallback and allows only exact PAPER origin, four fixed GET path/query pairs, and sanitized synthetic provider data. Production account client retains the fixed PAPER base URL and is constructed with configured credentials only in the non-local startup branch.

The Alpaca account client exposes only fixed GET account/positions/open-orders/clock reads and calls assertPaperOnly. The repository PAPER-only source guard passed. Local transport rejects unsupported origin/path/query/method before invoking the resource reader; no order-writing adapter operation is present.

Adapter errors expose a bounded failure kind, not provider response bodies or request headers. Local API logging is disabled; harness logs/traces retain bounded route/status/resource/error-kind fields, not request headers, payloads, or raw exceptions. Tests assert local placeholder credentials and a secret-sentinel fixture value are not leaked. Normalization projects provider records into explicit fields, so passthrough input fields are not returned in normalized account state.

Reviewed tests cover the integrated local reconcile transport path, four-resource call observation, failures and recovery, global fetch non-use, fixed-origin allowlist rejection, credential-free local configuration, sanitized errors/logs, and PAPER invariants.

limitations: This verdict covers local in-memory simulation and source-level safety properties. It does not qualify live Alpaca behavior or establish live broker/network credentials.
